comment: Explicit declarations for hybrid scenario-backed checks whose internal (repository-content) assertions do not yet have a mutation-backed injection proof. This file is the ratchet that replaced the silent 'contains spawnSync => wholesale exemption' classification: each gap is named and reasoned, NEW hybrids cannot be added silently (the governance check fails for them), and removing a declaration requires adding an injection entry. Tracked as follow-up work beyond change normalize-os-file-open-paths, which only proved its own boundary (task-9.1).
